## Data mtcars
```{r data_mtcars, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
data(mtcars)
head(mtcars)
summary(mtcars)
pairs(mtcars)
```

```{r mpg_vs_wt, echo=TRUE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
mtcars$group <- 0
mtcars$id <- 1:dim(mtcars)[1]
par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(4,4,0.5,0.5))
plot_num_vs_x_grouped(mtcars, y="mpg", x="wt", group="group", id="id")
```

```{r preparation_for_clustGLMM, echo=TRUE}
# outcomes and their families
family <- c("num") 
names(family) <- Ys <- c("mpg")

# ID variable
id <- "id"

# Regression model set up
formula <- list()
for(y in Ys){       # this creates the same formula for all outcomes (but in general they do not have to be the same!)
  formula[[y]] <- list()
  formula[[y]]$fixed <- ~ 1   # nothing
  formula[[y]]$group <- ~ wt  # group-specific slope
  formula[[y]]$random <- ~ 0  # no random effects
  formula[[y]]$offset <- ""   # no offset, could be omitted
}
```


```{r mcmc_first_call, message=FALSE, results=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
set.seed(12345)
mcmc <- clustGLMM(formula = formula, id = id, family = family, data = mtcars,
                  G = 3, iter = 1000, nchains = 3, howsave = "matrix")
```

```{r mcmc_first_call_summary, message=FALSE, echo=TRUE, results=TRUE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
mcmc
plot(mcmc)
```

```{r mcmc, message=FALSE, results=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
inits <- mcmc$last
mcmc <- clustGLMM(formula = formula, id = id, family = family, data = mtcars,
                  G = 3, 
                  inits = inits,
                  iter = 10000, nchains = 3, howsave = "matrix")

plot(mcmc, chains=1:3)
```





```{r clustering_probabilities, echo=TRUE, results=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
probs <- clustering_probabilities_and_deviance(mcmc, id, mtcars,
                                               dynamic_prob = FALSE,
                                               start = 1,
                                               end = mcmc$iter,
                                               thin = 1,
                                               chains = 1:mcmc$nchains,
                                               tolerance = 1e-7, 
                                               maxiter = 100,
                                               maxnrep = 20, 
                                               NGQ = 1)
plot(probs, "pUig_int", which="clusters_kerneldensity", chains = 1)
plot(probs, "dev_i", which="kerneldensity", chains = 1)
plot(probs, "deviance", which="kerneldensity", chains = 1)
```
